probe_sources.compare-corpus.py:
import os, signal, subprocess, time, json, re, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
deadline = time.monotonic() + 180
while not (p / 'regex-final-full-tests.json').exists():
    if time.monotonic() > deadline:
        raise RuntimeError('native unit gate has not terminated; no corpus started')
    time.sleep(2)
gate = json.loads((p / 'regex-final-full-tests.json').read_text())
assert gate['exit_code'] == 0 and gate['source_manifest_unchanged'] and not gate['timed_out'], gate
root = '/Users/chris/Code/Libraries/zig-js'
plans = [{k:r[k] for k in ('path','filter')} for r in json.loads((p.parent / 'regex-backref-continuations/after-corpus.json').read_text())['rows']]
results = {}
for label, binary in [('before',p/'before-test262'),('after',p/'engine-final/bin/test262')]:
    rows = []
    for i, plan in enumerate(plans):
        cmd = [str(binary),'--diag',plan['path']] + ([plan['filter']] if plan['filter'] else [])
        log = p/f'{label}-corpus-{i}.log'
        start = time.monotonic()
        with log.open('w') as out:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=root,stdout=out,stderr=out,start_new_session=True)
            try:
                code = proc.wait(timeout=60)
                timeout = False
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                proc.wait()
                code = 124
                timeout = True
        raw = log.read_text()
        summary = re.search(r'# .*?: (\d+) fail, (\d+) pass',raw)
        assert code == 0 and not timeout and summary and int(summary[1])+int(summary[2]) > 0, (label,plan,raw[-2000:])
        paths = sorted({line.split('\t',2)[1] for line in raw.splitlines() if '\t' in line})
        assert len(paths) == int(summary[1])
        rows.append({**plan,'failed':int(summary[1]),'passed':int(summary[2]),'failed_paths':paths,'exit_code':code,'timed_out':timeout,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,3),'log':log.name})
    results[label] = {'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'rows':rows}
    (p/f'{label}-corpus.json').write_text(json.dumps(results[label],indent=2)+'\n')
    print(label, sum(r['passed'] for r in rows), sum(r['failed'] for r in rows), flush=True)
comparison = []
for before, after in zip(results['before']['rows'],results['after']['rows']):
    comparison.append({'path':before['path'],'filter':before['filter'],'before_passed':before['passed'],'after_passed':after['passed'],'gains':sorted(set(before['failed_paths'])-set(after['failed_paths'])),'regressions':sorted(set(after['failed_paths'])-set(before['failed_paths']))})
(p/'corpus-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparison,indent=2)+'\n')
